This change is driven by political, regulatory, environmental and technological developments. Therefore, System Operations needs to adapt and develop its operation for the challenges of today and tomorrow. Within System Operations, we are developing novel concepts and processes to ensure TenneT is prepared to operate the future power system with the same level of reliability and security as we do today.
